items.q: How much does it cost to rent a hospital bed?
items.a: Rental starts from RM139/month for a 2-function bed, RM229/month for 3-function, and RM649/month for the 6-function electric bed. Every price includes a 2-year warranty and free training.
2 hours for KL & Selangor, 6-12 hours for Melaka, Johor, Penang, Perak and Negeri Sembilan, and 24 hours for the rest of Malaysia including Sabah & Sarawak.
When you buy a bed from us and no longer need it, we buy it back at 50% of the original purchase price. It's an exclusive guarantee from Ibnu Sina Care — no other company offers this.

items.q: Do I need to pay a deposit?
items.a: No! We are zero deposit. Pay when the bed arrives — COD (Cash On Delivery). There's no risk at all for you.
Yes! You can start by renting, and your rental payments count towards the purchase price. Once it's paid off, the bed is yours. No burden, and no large upfront payment.

items.q: Manual or electric bed — which is better?
items.a: Manual beds (2 & 3-function) suit patients who can still move a little, or short-term care. The electric bed (6-function) is best for fully bedridden patients — the remote control means the carer never has to lift the patient manually.
Installation carries a minimal charge. Our team delivers, assembles, and gives FREE usage training — so your family feels confident caring for the patient.

items.q: Who is a hospital bed suitable for?
items.a: It suits elderly people who need support, stroke patients, post-surgery patients, bedridden patients, and palliative care at home. A hospital bed helps reduce bedsore risk, makes breathing easier, and takes strain off the carer.

items.q: Does Ibnu Sina Care hold certifications and licences?
items.a: Yes! We hold KKM (Ministry of Health Malaysia) certification and meet Medical Device Authority (MDA) standards. We are also an authorised ResMed dealer for CPAP machines in Malaysia, operating since 2016.
Of course! We have 5 showrooms in KL, Penang, Melaka, Johor Bahru and Langkawi. Just come by — see, feel and try every model before deciding. WhatsApp us to book an appointment.
